+ "b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,len2=dx*dx+dy*dy;\n    if(len2<1e-12)continue;\n    var len=Math.sqrt(len2),ts=[0,1];\n    for(var j=0;j<m;j++){\n      var c=Q[j],d=Q[(j+1)%m],ex=d.x-c.x,ey=d.y-c.y,elen=Math.sqrt(ex*ex+ey*ey);\n      if(elen<1e-12)continue;\n      var den=g34Cross(dx,dy,ex,ey);\n      if(Math.abs(den)>1e-9*len*elen){\n        var t=g34Cross(c.x-a.x,c.y-a.y,ex,ey)/den,u=g34Cross(c.x-a.x,c.y-a.y,dx,dy)/den;\n        var te=eps/len,ue=eps/elen;\n        if(t>-te&&t<1+te&&u>-ue&&u<1+ue){ts.push(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t)));}\n      }else{\n        var dist=Math.abs(g34Cross(c.x-a.x,c.y-a.y,dx,dy))/len;\n        if(dist<eps){\n          var rr=[c,d];\n          for(var k=0;k<2;k++){var tt=((rr[k].x-a.x)*dx+(rr[k].y-a.y)*dy)/len2;if(tt>0&&tt<1)ts.push(tt);}\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    ts.sort(function(x,y){return x-y;});\n    var prev=ts[0];\n    for(var s=1;s<ts.length;s++){\n      var "

+ "x)/2,y:(s.a.y+s.b.y)/2};w=g34Where(m,B,eps);\n    if(w.s===\"out\")keep.push(s);\n    else if(w.s===\"on\"&&((s.b.x-s.a.x)*w.dx+(s.b.y-s.a.y)*w.dy)>0)keep.push(s);\n  }\n  for(i=0;i<SB.length;i++){\n    s=SB[i];m={x:(s.a.x+s.b.x)/2,y:(s.a.y+s.b.y)/2};w=g34Where(m,A,eps);\n    if(w.s===\"out\")keep.push(s);\n  }\n  /* vertices unicos (tolerancia) */\n  var pts=[],grid={},cell=eps*8;\n  function vid(p){\n    var cx=Math.floor(p.x/cell),cy=Math.floor(p.y/cell);\n    for(var dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)for(var dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++){\n      var l=grid[(cx+dx)+\"_\"+(cy+dy)];\n      if(l)for(var k=0;k<l.length;k++){var q=pts[l[k]];if(Math.abs(q.x-p.x)<eps*2&&Math.abs(q.y-p.y)<eps*2)return l[k];}\n    }\n    pts.push({x:p.x,y:p.y});var id=pts.length-1,key=cx+\"_\"+cy;(grid[key]=grid[key]||[]).push(id);return id;\n  }\n  var E=[],out={};\n  for(i=0;i<keep.length;i++){\n    var a=vid(keep[i].a),b=vid(keep[i].b)"
+ ";\n    if(a===b)continue;\n    E.push({a:a,b:b,used:false});(out[a]=out[a]||[]).push(E.length-1);\n  }\n  var loops=[];\n  for(i=0;i<E.length;i++){\n    if(E[i].used)continue;\n    var start=E[i].a,cur=E[i],L=[],guard=0,ok=false;\n    while(cur&&guard++<100000){\n      cur.used=true;L.push(pts[cur.a]);\n      if(cur.b===start){ok=true;break;}\n      var cand=out[cur.b]||[],nx=null;\n      for(var k=0;k<cand.length;k++)if(!E[cand[k]].used){nx=E[cand[k]];break;}\n      cur=nx;\n    }\n    if(ok&&L.length>=3)loops.push(g34Clean(L,eps*4));\n  }\n  loops=loops.filter(function(l){return l.length>=3&&Math.abs(g34Area(l))>eps*eps*10;});\n  if(!loops.length)return null;\n  loops.sort(function(x,y){return Math.abs(g34Area(y))-Math.abs(g34Area(x));});\n  var chain=g34Bridge(loops);\n  return{points:chain,loops:loops.length};\n}\n/* contorno de um retangulo com cantos elipticos, em coordenadas relat"
+ "ivas ao centro */\nfunction g34RoundRect(w,h,r,S){\n  var f=1;\n  function lim(a,b,l){if(a+b>l&&a+b>0)f=Math.min(f,l/(a+b));}\n  lim(r.tlx,r.trx,w);lim(r.blx,r.brx,w);lim(r.tly,r.bly,h);lim(r.try_,r.bry,h);\n  var C=[\n    {cx:-w/2+r.tlx*f,cy:-h/2+r.tly*f,rx:r.tlx*f,ry:r.tly*f,a0:Math.PI},\n    {cx:w/2-r.trx*f,cy:-h/2+r.try_*f,rx:r.trx*f,ry:r.try_*f,a0:Math.PI*1.5},\n    {cx:w/2-r.brx*f,cy:h/2-r.bry*f,rx:r.brx*f,ry:r.bry*f,a0:0},\n    {cx:-w/2+r.blx*f,cy:h/2-r.bly*f,rx:r.blx*f,ry:r.bly*f,a0:Math.PI/2}\n  ],P=[];\n  for(var i=0;i<4;i++){\n    var c=C[i];\n    if(c.rx<0.01||c.ry<0.01){\n      var px=(i===0||i===3)?-w/2:w/2,py=(i<2)?-h/2:h/2;P.push({x:px,y:py});continue;\n    }\n    for(var k=0;k<=S;k++){var a=c.a0+Math.PI/2*k/S;P.push({x:c.cx+c.rx*Math.cos(a),y:c.cy+c.ry*Math.sin(a)});}\n  }\n  var R=[];\n  for(var j=0;j<P.length;j++){var q=R[R.length-1];if(!q||Math.abs(q.x-P[j].x)>1e-6||M"
+ "ath.abs(q.y-P[j].y)>1e-6)R.push(P[j]);}\n  if(R.length>1&&Math.abs(R[0].x-R[R.length-1].x)<1e-6&&Math.abs(R[0].y-R[R.length-1].y)<1e-6)R.pop();\n  return R;\n}\n/* verdadeiro se as AREAS dos dois poligonos se sobrepoem (encostar so na borda nao conta) */\nfunction g34Overlap(A,B){\n  var eps=1e-6;\n  function samples(P){var S=[],n=P.length,cx=0,cy=0;for(var i=0;i<n;i++){S.push(P[i]);var q=P[(i+1)%n];S.push({x:(P[i].x+q.x)/2,y:(P[i].y+q.y)/2});cx+=P[i].x;cy+=P[i].y;}S.push({x:cx/n,y:cy/n});return S;}\n  function anyIn(S,Q){for(var i=0;i<S.length;i++)if(g34Where(S[i],Q,1e-4).s===\"in\")return true;return false;}\n  if(anyIn(samples(A),B)||anyIn(samples(B),A))return true;\n  for(var i=0;i<A.length;i++){\n    var a=A[i],b=A[(i+1)%A.length];\n    for(var j=0;j<B.length;j++){\n      var c=B[j],d=B[(j+1)%B.length];\n      var d1=g34Cross(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y,c.x-a.x,c.y-a.y),d2=g34Cross(b.x-a.x,b.y-"
+ "a.y,d.x-a.x,d.y-a.y);\n      var d3=g34Cross(d.x-c.x,d.y-c.y,a.x-c.x,a.y-c.y),d4=g34Cross(d.x-c.x,d.y-c.y,b.x-c.x,b.y-c.y);\n      if(((d1>eps&&d2<-eps)||(d1<-eps&&d2>eps))&&((d3>eps&&d4<-eps)||(d3<-eps&&d4>eps)))return true;\n    }\n  }\n  return false;\n}\n\n/* junta varios contornos em uma unica lista de pontos usando pontes de largura zero */\n/* operacoes booleanas: union | intersect | subtract (A menos B) */\nfunction g34Bool(A,B,op){\n  if(g34Area(A)<0)A=A.slice().reverse();\n  if(g34Area(B)<0)B=B.slice().reverse();\n  var xs=A.concat(B).map(function(p){return p.x;}),ys=A.concat(B).map(function(p){return p.y;});\n  var size=Math.max(Math.max.apply(null,xs)-Math.min.apply(null,xs),Math.max.apply(null,ys)-Math.min.apply(null,ys),1);\n  var eps=Math.max(1e-4,size*1e-6*4);\n  var SA=g34Split(A,B,eps),SB=g34Split(B,A,eps),keep=[],i,s,w,m;\n  for(i=0;i<SA.length;i++){\n    s=SA[i];m={x:"
+ "(s.a.x+s.b.x)/2,y:(s.a.y+s.b.y)/2};w=g34Where(m,B,eps);\n    var same=w.s===\"on\"&&((s.b.x-s.a.x)*w.dx+(s.b.y-s.a.y)*w.dy)>0;\n    if(op===\"union\"){if(w.s===\"out\"||same)keep.push(s);}\n    else if(op===\"intersect\"){if(w.s===\"in\"||same)keep.push(s);}\n    else{if(w.s===\"out\"||(w.s===\"on\"&&!same))keep.push(s);}\n  }\n  for(i=0;i<SB.length;i++){\n    s=SB[i];m={x:(s.a.x+s.b.x)/2,y:(s.a.y+s.b.y)/2};w=g34Where(m,A,eps);\n    if(op===\"union\"){if(w.s===\"out\")keep.push(s);}\n    else if(op===\"intersect\"){if(w.s===\"in\")keep.push(s);}\n    else if(w.s===\"in\")keep.push({a:s.b,b:s.a});\n  }\n\n  /* vertices unicos (tolerancia) */\n  var pts=[],grid={},cell=eps*8;\n  function vid(p){\n    var cx=Math.floor(p.x/cell),cy=Math.floor(p.y/cell);\n    for(var dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)for(var dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++){\n      var l=grid[(cx+dx)+\"_\"+(cy+dy)];\n      if(l)for(var k=0;k<l.length;k++){"
